cause: The closed hard model validated its previous native tick by subtracting 0.1 from timeSec. At native tick 162 this yielded a value below the real preceding native tick 161. The strictly future-created parcel check rejected two legitimate 16.1-second releases, so the hard tick stopped while native time advanced. Physical support, food and condition budgets were valid; no window or food fixture was changed.
minimalFix: Reconstruct expected validator time as (sim._ticks - (pending ? 1 : 0)) * 0.1 from the already validated integer native tick count. Preserve strict future timestamp, physical geometry and stock validation.

regression.firstRegressionAssertionCorrection: The initial regression assertion manually added seconds to 16.1 and got a different floating value from the native integer tick clock. It was corrected to use (ticks + 1) * 0.1, matching the actual simulator. The source fix was unchanged.
